name: Fans and blowers
summary: Fans and blowers that move air, from small 12V computer fans to mains blower wheels.
uses: Blowers for forges and rocket stoves
identify: Square 12V fans in computers, power supplies, inverters and amplifiers; squirrel-cage blowers in furnaces, range hoods and air handlers; mains axial fans in fridges, bathrooms and AC condensers.
test: Spin it by hand: it should coast freely. Feed DC fans 12V (red +, black −) or plug in mains fans, and listen for grinding.

decay.note: Lasts. Dry bearings get noisy, but a drop of oil helps.
